design: Acquire once per question; identical saved bodies, passage coverage and input packet for both review arms. Compare prompt and acceptance only, not independent live search recall.

gate.expansion_requires: Completed blinded material labels, coverage improvement, no material regression, and audited costs; no automatic expansion from job success.

cases.question: Will Anthropic be a designated supply chain risk on May 1, 2026?
required_materials: Dated government designation or legal notice identifying the exact Anthropic entity and status on May 1, 2026
Applicable authority, effective date and distinction between proposed, stayed and operative designation

cases.question: Will Tesla discontinue the Cybertruck before April 1, 2026?
required_materials: Tesla issuer notice or filing describing Cybertruck production/discontinuation status before April 1, 2026
Exact product identity and dated evidence distinguishing temporary production pause, trim removal and permanent discontinuation

cases.question: Will Anthropic file an initial registration statement (S-1) with the SEC to launch an IPO, before July 1, 2026?
required_materials: SEC EDGAR filing records matching the Anthropic legal issuer and S-1 form before July 1, 2026
Issuer identifiers, filing dates and explicit distinction from amended S-1, confidential draft and unrelated same-name issuers

cases.question: Will a new High Representative for Bosnia and Herzegovina officially be in place before September 2, 2026?
required_materials: Official OHR or appointing-authority notice identifying the High Representative and effective status before September 2, 2026
Appointment announcement versus effective assumption of office and replacement identity

cases.question: Will the United States provide written notices of withdrawal from the USMCA before September 2026?
required_materials: Official USMCA withdrawal notice or dated government document through August 2026
Written transmission, recipient, notice date and distinction from renegotiation statements or threats

cases.question: What will SpaceX's closing market capitalization be on its first day of trading as a public company?
required_materials: First-trading-day SpaceX public equity market record, or explicit unlocated/not-yet-listed status gap
Closing price, share-count basis, currency, date and market-cap calculation inputs; private valuation is not public closing capitalization

cases.question: How many parties will obtain representation in the 2026 Kazakh legislative election?
required_materials: Official Kazakhstan legislative election result with parties obtaining seats
Election date, seat/party table, legislative chamber, threshold and provisional-versus-final status

cases.question: In Louisiana v. Callais, will SCOTUS strike down Louisiana’s two majority-Black districts, restoring a GOP-leaning map?
required_materials: Louisiana v. Callais official merits opinion or disposition, preserving full judgment text or explicit absent-opinion gap
Case identifiers, decision date and distinction among district boundaries, constitutional holding, injunction and procedural disposition

cases.question: Will the United Arab Emirates conduct a direct military strike against Iran before June 1, 2026?
required_materials: Dated source records identifying a UAE direct military strike against Iran before June 1, 2026 or explicit unlocated evidence gap
Actor, target, event date and direct strike versus interception, proxy participation or unconfirmed allegation

cases.question: When Will an AI be Amongst the Best Forecasters on Metaculus
required_materials: Metaculus leaderboard or benchmark record describing AI forecasting performance under the question rules
Scoring definition, eligibility, measurement window, rank and comparison population; promotional accuracy alone does not fulfill the benchmark
